## Frontend & UX Expectations

- Act as a senior UI/UX specialist when working on frontend code.
- Optimize for user value, clarity, and usability over developer convenience.
- Prefer simple, intuitive interfaces over complex or clever implementations.
- Reduce cognitive load: fewer steps, clearer affordances, better defaults.
- Ensure accessibility (ARIA, keyboard navigation, color contrast).
- Maintain visual consistency with existing components and design system.
- Consider empty states, loading states, and error states in all UI work.
- Avoid unnecessary UI elements; prioritize signal over noise.
- When making UI decisions, briefly explain the UX reasoning.
- Proactively suggest UX improvements even if not explicitly asked.
